observed: The shared scan chooses the first free location even when a same-class copy peer already has another free location. The whole-pool retry failure is closed by T1. N01 attributes 12,952 excess move bytes across the five libraries and 6,712 excess stack bytes to inflate; these are prioritization signals, not a promise that hints recover them.

engineering_reference.principle: Try hints before ordinary preferred registers, while retaining the full allocation-map conflict checks. No regalloc2 algorithm/proof claim or wholesale allocator replacement.

scope.included: An opt-in preference for an already-assigned or fixed same-class copy peer's physical location, before the existing first-free choice. Inspect peers in deterministic instruction order. A hint must be in the original class/across-call pool and not held, pinned or clobbered anywhere in the existing interval. Do not open an additional callee-save location when the ordinary free choice avoids one.
scope.unchanged: Live ranges and overlap rules, ABI pinning, tied/fixed/early-clobber handling, spill-victim priority, T1 progress bound, spill placement/slot compaction, register pools, cycle scratch and independent verifier. No merging of interfering live ranges, new opcode, IR/interpreter/registry change or default optimization flip.
scope.identity_copies: Reuse the existing identity-copy removal only when physical locations and classes agree. Add long-chain, selected-edge/cycle and multiply-defined-value controls. If these expose a pre-existing defect, retain a bounded RED and repair it separately before broader hint admission; never weaken the verifier.
scope.excluded: Global allocator, interval splitting, rematerialization, call scheduling beyond T1, new callee-save policy, cross-class coalescing, FP/vector semantics, memory optimization, new audit layer and runtime latency.
scope.default: OFF; kernel markers, patchable entry and explicit frame-pointer requests suppress the new allocator choice. Ordinary legacy entry points preserve OFF behavior.

interface.driver: --regalloc-opt=copy-hints, once only; exact spelling shared by native IR adapter. Record request in native assembly header. Reject unknown/duplicate values and --check combinations. A test-only environment hook extends the existing native-corpus adapter, not production behavior.
interface.generic: Explicit allocation options with a default-OFF compatibility wrapper; no ISA names in generic code.
interface.spec: EvoMIR implementation-policy revision for optional candidate order and protected profiles; instruction semantics unchanged.

red: Same-class dying source allocated to a non-first location: OFF retains the move, ON can remove it; independently verify allocation and transported values.
Future fixed call/return locations may hint an earlier interval only if the original whole-interval conflict checks permit it.
Still-live source, overlapping peer, class/width mismatch, early-clobber, fixed/tied asm and reserved registers must not bypass existing constraints.
Full-width live-across-call values still spill when the original target pool is empty; don't borrow partially preserved registers.
Long copy chains, multi-definition out-of-SSA values, selected indirect edges, parallel-copy cycles and forged assignments remain correct/rejected as appropriate.
Public native option parsing, protected profiles, no-option exact output and C driver examples exercise the implemented path rather than a helper-only test.

acceptance.native: Existing 384 Darwin and 384 sealed Linux cases ON/OFF; both object twins byte-identical; OFF all hashes equal T1 logs; independent verifier unchanged. Native correctness, no latency.
acceptance.six_units: Six frozen A/B measurement plans: OFF, copy-only and cumulative frame+C1+copy. Exclude unadmitted C2 local selection. Same six TUs, both profiles, original selected-TU harnesses, zero completed proof rejection/bundle failure. Match OFF objects to T1. Report copy-only and combined size separately, not as EqSat gains.

bounds.comparison: copy-only and cumulative each against matched fresh OFF; also show cumulative versus historical frame+C1 size, without upgrading C2 or T1 cost dispositions.

acceptance.coverage: Retain N02's 70 admitted inputs, 187 opaque cases and integer-mix source-event mismatch. No full-app/kernel admission inferred from selected-TU harnesses.
gates: focused Rust and touched Python tests
acceptance.stop: A hint never forces a location. If correctness cannot be repaired within existing rules, decline it and retain the RED. Freeze zero/negative size or cost results; do not grow heuristics or rerun to erase misses. Broader N03c spill quality requires its own frozen slice.

resources.retention: Hash/measure then retire idle intermediate objects; keep summaries, receipts and reduced reproducers. No full disassembly, new target/workspace/kernel tree or VM disk. Record scoped cache/evidence net growth.

claim_ceiling: Optional candidate-order hint on the frozen population, validated per allocated output. Not interference-relaxing coalescing, a complete allocator, backend proof, verified EqSat gain, default admission or full N03c/N07 closure.
